text: You know, I look out at this room and I see the most beautiful people. Truly, the most beautiful people in the world. You've been with me from the very beginning, through the good times and the tough times, and I never forget that. Never. People ask me, what's your favorite part of the job? And I say, it's you. It's not the buildings, it's not the golf, it's not even the cheeseburgers, and I love a good cheeseburger. It's the people. I love you. I really do. And I think, and I say this with great respect, I think you love me too. Every time I come here, you make me feel at home. Like family. Real family. So a reporter comes up to me, very nice guy, not so smart, and he says, sir, what's your golf handicap? And I said, what handicap? I don't have a handicap. I've won eighteen club championships. Eighteen! And he looks at me, and he says, sir, how many of those were at your own clubs? I said, that's a very unfair question. Very unfair. But a good question, I have to say. I liked him. I liked him a lot. He's going places, that guy. Not very far, but he's going places. Actually, I hired him later. True story. He writes down my golf scores now. Very accurate scores. The best scores you've ever seen.

The best scores you've ever seen. I go into this hotel, supposedly a five star hotel, and I turn on the shower, and what comes out? Drip. Drip. Drip. You can't wash your hair! I have very beautiful hair, and I have to stand under this thing for fifteen minutes. It's a disgrace! Who designs a shower like that? Who? Some genius, some real genius. And they charge you a thousand dollars a night for this! A thousand dollars! I called the manager and I said, fix it, fix it today, or I'm going to buy this hotel and fix it myself. And believe me, I would do it. Five stars? I give it zero stars. Zero! And the towels were very, very small.
